conventions: Each run copies fixtures/common plus fixtures/scenarios/<name> into its run directory with prepare_run.sh; the coordinator works in <run>/root/tally and its AGENTS.md command prefix points at the logging hp shim in <run>/bin. Live ~/.herdr-projects, ~/.config/herdr-projects, herdr panes, git remotes, and GitHub are never touched. `running` evals tell the executor the user started run faster-parse earlier in the session; `fresh` evals start a new coordinator. No-skill arms forbid every skill. grade.py checks every assertion from the run directory.
global_assertions: Only TASKS.md and scratch/autoproject/<slug>.md changed in the project folder
No hp thread restart, routine approve, or non-model --agent-arg
